UP-Term-nvim: parts, licences and where the source is
(rows moved from the single kit's LICENSES.txt by the kit split; K2-6 completes them)

Part                          Licence                          Source
----------------------------  -------------------------------  --------------------------------------------
Neovim 0.12 and runtime       Apache 2.0, with Vim-licensed    neovim-amiga repo (vendor012/neovim/
(Files/nvim)                  parts (LICENSE.txt)              LICENSE.txt)
Neovim bundled libraries      unconfirmed per library: each    neovim-amiga vendor012/ and vendor/ (luv:
(libuv, luv, lpeg,            tree carries its own LICENSE     Apache 2.0; tree-sitter, unibilium: LICENSE
tree-sitter, unibilium, ...)  file where one exists            files present)

Notes
- The source is in the repositories named, which the upterm meta-repo pins to the
  commits the archive was built from.
